sichek.description: scitix node health checker — read-only checks only: all + the gpu/infiniband/gpfs/lldp components (and their aliases g/i/f/l). daemon, config sync, exporter, and standalone perf tests (ibtest/rocetest/nccltest) are blocked because their position-0 subcommand is not in the allowlist. Note: `sichek all` runs the full default read-only component set (cpu/ethernet/dmesg/transceiver too), and triggers a small NCCL benchmark + PCIe topo only if the node's user-config enables those components (not the default).

mmlscluster.description: IBM Spectrum Scale (GPFS) cluster configuration query — the node/manager layout behind a shared filesystem, read next to mount/findmnt when a node's GPFS mount is the subject. Read-only: the mm* family splits along its verb and every writer is a SEPARATE binary (mmchcluster, mmcrfs, mmdelnode, mmshutdown), none of which is whitelisted. Invoked by its absolute path (/usr/lpp/mmfs/bin/mmlscluster), which resolves to this basename. Takes no operands — only --ces / --cnfs / --cloud-gateway — so operands are blocked.
